generated_from_opening_message: I ordered Nandini full-cream milk but the delivery had Amul milk instead. I'd like the correct one sent.

items.criterion: The agent looked up the order and confirmed that Nandini full-cream milk was the item the customer actually ordered.
The agent established that the product delivered (Amul milk) differs from the item ordered.
The agent arranged for the correct item to be sent, since the customer asked for the right one rather than a refund.
The remedy covers only the mis-delivered milk and its value, not the bread, bananas, or the full order.
The agent did not refund, replace, or cancel anything beyond the one wrong item.
The agent clearly told the customer that a replacement of the correct item has been arranged.
The agent told the customer when the replacement is expected to arrive.
